method: imagegen edit of checksum-bound original coloring illustration
visual_review: All eighteen outputs opened and visually inspected. Subject, scene, framing and color coverage reviewed. Pixel-exact contour alignment is not proven by generated edits.
base_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: provided original black-and-white coloring illustration. Color only the enclosed white regions of THIS EXACT drawing. Keep every black contour, fine line, object position, silhouette, framing, margin, aspect ratio and crop absolutely unchanged. Preserve the source canvas dimensions 1024 x 1536. Do not redraw, add, remove, move, reinterpret, simplify or crop anything. This will be aligned pixel-for-pixel over the source in a comparison slider, so geometry must remain identical. Fully colored professional coloring-book preview with vivid but tasteful marker colors and gentle color-only gradients; black linework remains on top. No text, watermark, UI, split line or partial uncolored half. Palette:
